messages:
morgan: Hi everyone, quick onboarding question — which Console roles should I request for staging vs prod? I need to flip a feature flag briefly to reproduce a bug and run integration tests against the Console API. cc @ben
ben: Welcome! For staging ask for `console-staging-admin`. For prod, keep it minimal: `console-prod-readonly` + `prod-ff-operator` for short toggles. Don’t request prod admin permanently, use JIT admin when needed.
lina: Also include manager approval and a short justification in the request. Security checks those. Use the template: team / env / roles / reason / duration / manager. I can approve once it’s filed.
infra-bot: Docs: https://go/redwood/access-matrix. CLI helper: `infra request_access --env prod --role prod-ff-operator --duration 4h`
morgan: Thanks! One more — for CI against Console should I use the team service account or create personal creds?
ben: Use the team SA (team-ml-ci). Personal SAs with prod scope are discouraged. If you need short-lived creds we can issue rotating tokens.
morgan: Filed the request and added @lina for approval. Will tag #ff-changes if the toggle might affect customers. Thanks for the help :)
